status: protocol and method-specific coefficients frozen before prospective evaluation

primary_policy.model: four independent L2-regularized logistic regressions, one per pruned budget
primary_policy.risk_calibration: one-sided 95% Wilson upper confidence bound on full-population unsafe acceptance must not exceed 0.05
primary_policy.selection: choose the smallest budget whose predicted reference-safety probability exceeds the development-calibrated threshold; otherwise execute dense
primary_policy.execution_limit: exactly one VLM inference per query
primary_policy.fallback: no post-hoc dense fallback after returning a pruned answer

secondary_non_deployment_analysis.reason: a 64-token probe followed by dense fallback is not energy-positive at the observed conservative acceptance rates

development_data.grouping: connected components of identical image content and exact normalized non-template questions; repeated benchmark templates are retained as task structure

prospective_test.label_timing: labels hidden until after every action is executed
prospective_test.required_accounting: one selected action per query plus controller CPU time; evaluator interventions reported separately
